title: Somatic mobility of transposons is explosive and shaped by distinct integration biases in Arabidopsis thaliana.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Listed the Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.20143080 (MIT licence) and the GitHub repo hAmbreen02/deNOVOEnrich: they hold only the pipeline script, TE (transposable element) flanking-sequence/loci BED inputs, a centromere repeat BED and a small AtCOPIA93 test run; no genome-wide table of the ~200,000 somatic insertions. NCBI SRA search on PRJNA1270934 returns 12 entries of raw reads. Europe PMC supplementaryFiles endpoint timed out (120 s), so Additional files 1-7 were not retrievable.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: The ~200,000 somatic insertion count, per-sample counts (e.g. 21,509 ONSEN insertions in heat-stressed met1), and the existence of supplementary Data 4-7 (WGS-detected insertions, hotspots, 170 R genes, 62 biosynthetic genes) come only from the paper text.

a1_downloadable.note: The processed insertion calls behind the ~200,000 figure are not deposited in Zenodo/GitHub; only raw SRA reads (12 entries) are. The supplement was not retrievable, and per its captions holds only WGS insertions, hotspots and two small gene lists.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: A model of integration-site preference needs insertion (positive) vs. non-insertion (background) genomic windows; that label would have to be built by rerunning deNOVOEnrich on raw reads and sampling background sites. Checked repo contents, not the supplement.

a3_inputs_present.note: Chromatin-mark features (H2A.Z, H3K27me3, etc.) would need reprocessing of public ChIP-seq listed in Table S4; not present as a table.

a4_units_stated.note: Genomic coordinates in BED format; units not an issue (from repo test output).

a5_enough_rows.note: Paper claims ~200,000 insertions; not verified because no processed table was found.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: Raw TEd-seq FASTQ from SRA, size not checked
a6_fits_laptop.note: Rebuilding labels requires downloading and aligning raw sequencing data, which the project rules forbid.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No processed count available to compare with the paper's ~200,000.

a8_label_provenance.note: Insertions are measured by TE-enrichment sequencing (TEd-seq) and called by a pipeline; physical measurement, not another model's prediction.

backbone.name: DNABERT-2 or Nucleotide Transformer (DNA language models) would fit in principle
backbone.hardware: CPU for embeddings of short windows

integration.partner_dataset: Public Arabidopsis ChIP-seq (Table S4 of paper), Araport11 gene annotation
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Do sequence and chromatin context predict where each retrotransposon family lands in somatic cells?

controls.positive_control: Known EVADE enrichment in genes/H3K27me3 and depletion in H3K9me2 heterochromatin
controls.negative_control: Shuffle insertion labels across matched background windows
controls.external_validation: Germline ONSEN/EVADE insertion maps from earlier studies (not retrieved)

honest_claim_h3: Would predict where three heat- or mutant-activated retrotransposon families insert in leaves of Col-0 Arabidopsis epigenetic mutants, among insertions detectable by TEd-seq; but the insertion table is not available to build it.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use DNA sequence and chromatin marks around a genomic window to predict whether a jumping gene inserts there in plant body cells.
plain_idea.train_on: Genomic windows from Arabidopsis with their sequence and histone-mark levels; number unknown because the ~200,000 insertion calls were not found as a downloadable table.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a new transposon insertion was detected in that window, measured by transposon-enrichment sequencing of pooled leaves.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Plant transposon biologists would learn which chromatin features drive each family's insertion choice, beyond enrichment statistics.

label_elsewhere.sources: Earlier Arabidopsis germline TE insertion maps (e.g. ONSEN/EVADE studies cited by the paper; not retrieved here)
label_elsewhere.why: Not filled in detail because Part A failed.

ml_idea: Classify somatic TE insertion vs. matched background windows from DNA-language-model embeddings plus histone marks, per TE family; blocked because insertion calls are not deposited in processed form.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated: labels would need to be rebuilt from raw SRA reads.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Retrieve Additional files 4-5 from the journal supplement and see whether a full per-insertion coordinate table for TEd-seq exists.

verdict_reason: Fails A1/A2/A3: the ~200,000 somatic insertion calls are not deposited as a processed table (Zenodo/GitHub hold only pipeline code and a test run; SRA holds raw reads), and the supplement was unreachable, so labels and chromatin features would have to be rebuilt from raw sequencing.
